review_scope: The 10 QWEN_FIT candidates selected into qwen-primary. Qwen semantic FIT is treated as a recall/routing signal only; DCE and GPT Web review remain authoritative for business actionability.

items.title: F--FY26 BMDO ROADSIDE FUELBREAK HERBICIDE
items.reason: Roadside fuelbreak herbicide / vegetation-management work, not a digital/creative/software delivery. The notice is also a Total Small Business Set Aside. Qwen FIT is a false positive.

items.title: Romania Integrated Nutrient Pollution Control Project
items.reason: General Procurement Notice / pre-tender radar rather than a specific actionable contract. Keep for downstream sub-procurement discovery, but do not count as GREEN.

items.title: F--Soils Sampling, Sequoia and Kings NPs
items.reason: Soils sampling field work and the notice states intent to award sole source. Not a relevant SPM delivery and not a normal open competition.

items.title: Request for Tender for Roof Repairs at An Grianan Adult Education College, Termonfeckin, Co. Louth
items.reason: Roof repair construction works. Substantive DCE exists but the underlying scope is outside the digital/creative/software business. Qwen FIT is a false positive.

items.title: Provision of Media Buying Planning Services and Creative Strategic Services for the Mental Health Commission
items.reason: Lot 2 Strategic & Creative Services is genuinely aligned: campaign strategy, creative concepts, copy/content/assets, digital/social/online video and integrated creative delivery. The DCE is substantive. Do not promote to strict GREEN yet because bidder-side agency capacity, portfolio/experience and the material insurance requirements still need to be checked against the actual bidder setup.

items.title: AXLE ASSEMBLY AUTOMATION
items.reason: Industrial axle-assembly automation and the source record is an Award Notice, not an open digital-services opportunity. Qwen FIT is a false positive.

items.title: France - Motor vehicles - Acquisition de vehicules d'occasions de types fourgons
items.reason: Procurement of used vans. Not a digital/creative/software service. Qwen FIT is a false positive.

items.title: Czechia - Archaeological services - D0 518 Ruzyne - Suchdol - Doplnujici casti zakladni studie archeologickych rizik
items.reason: Specialist archaeological services. Not a lean digital/creative/software opportunity. Qwen FIT is a false positive.

items.title: HH-60W Degraded Visual Environment System (DVES) - FA8552-26-R-B001
items.reason: Air Force helicopter DVE hardware/system engineering, integration, testing, installation and deployment. This is major aerospace/defense systems work, not the target lean service lane.

items.title: U.S. Army Contracting Command - Detroit Arsenal Strategic Services Branch Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO)
items.reason: This one is a real thematic hit: the notice explicitly includes IT hardware/software/services, museum exhibit design, modeling and simulation, transcription services and other support services, and says traditional and non-traditional defense contractors may receive awards. It is an umbrella CSO rather than one concrete task, so eligibility, foreign-bidder constraints, security/export-control implications and the actual submission vehicle still require DCE-level review before GREEN.
